title: Lantern Alley: Wire Puzzle
short: Turn wire tiles to light every lantern in a night alley. Three new alleys every day.
desc:
Night has fallen on the alley, and copper wires run tangled from the generator in the middle. Each tap turns a tile a quarter turn, and every wire connected to the generator lights up right away. Light every paper lantern with no loose wire ends left and the alley glows.

· Today's alleys: three puzzles (4×5, 5×6, 6×7) set by the date. Everyone gets the same alleys on the same day.
· Turn goal: fewer turns earn more stars.
· Lantern string: each day you light all three of today's alleys, a lantern is hung on a calendar-style string.
· Free alleys: a practice mode whose alleys grow up to 6×8 as you climb levels.
· Reset tiles: put a puzzle back to its starting layout at any time.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
